story_type: rocket artillery live fire, HIMARS launches
hook: Each white trail is a rocket leaving the back of a truck.
narration: Every one of those white trails is a rocket leaving the back of a truck.
U.S. Army artillery soldiers fired these launchers in the Philippines, in April 2026.
The truck is a HIMARS. Each launcher pod holds six guided rockets.
The launcher swings up, takes aim, and fires.
The whole idea is to fire, then drive off fast, so the spot is empty by the time anyone shoots back.
[short pause] Across the valley, another one went.
outcome: The crews fired their rockets, folded the launchers down, and drove off the firing point.
title: HIMARS rockets fired across a valley
description:
Soldiers with 2nd Battalion, 11th Field Artillery Regiment, 25th Infantry Division Artillery, fired High Mobility Artillery Rocket System launchers during Exercise Salaknib 2026 at Canantong, Laur, Nueva Ecija, Philippines, on April 16, 2026.

Footage: U.S. Army video by Sgt. Duke Edwards, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1002879/tropic-lightning-himars-strike-builds-allied-readiness
